name: research-humanizer
description: Full-paper research writing with ARS integration, source-bound humanizing, literature and metric checks, real figures, and Word preservation. English + Thai.

interface.longDescription: Draft full research papers with an optional ARS workflow, current literature and metric planning, research-specific prose, original study images, reproducible graphs and Word-first checks. Confirm study decisions and never invent missing evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use research-paper-craft in full-paper mode with my research materials. Apply its research style from the first draft, search relevant papers and official venue requirements, and ask for missing evidence.
